# Central weekly 1/5/26

Happy new year, everyone! Hope you all had a restful break and survived the inbox avalanche this morning. Here is where the Central pod stands for the week of 5 Jan 2026.

| Account | Focus this week | Next milestone |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Marrow Fieldworks | Ownership transition to Tobias Rendle | Intro call with Salina yard leads on 7 Jan 2026 |
| Tansley Parcel | Renewal paperwork and procurement review | Renewal due by 31 Jan 2026 |
| Marrow Agrisupply | Pooled queue coverage | Ticket #4418 fix on 8 Jan 2026 |

**Account handoffs and renewals**

Today is the official transition day for Marrow Fieldworks. We finished moving the open tickets and CRM tasks over from Pree's old dealer account before lunch. Tobias's dealer account has a Thursday morning check-in scheduled so the Salina and Kearney equipment yards can meet him and review their winter Combine Bay B gate schedules. 

With that handoff wrapped up, Pree is focusing on the Tansley Parcel renewal, which is due by 31 Jan 2026. Lev Arkadin asked for a clean export of their Q4 gate-house check-in logs at the Little Rock hub before he sends the paperwork through his legal queue. The account Pree runs also has two night-shift dispatchers requesting updated PDF printouts for the South Dock Door 14 kiosk, so she is sending those training sheets over this afternoon.

**Pooled queue notes**

On Marrow Agrisupply, whoever pulls the afternoon rotation today should check Ticket #4418. Their Topeka feed warehouse reported that the Gate 3 barcode scanner is dropping carrier check-ins when drivers arrive more than twenty minutes early for fertilizer drops. Let's get a reproduction log over to support before the 6 Jan 2026 morning standup.
